title: Meeting Loop install profile
description: One install = one profile. Answers the questions that change behavior; everything else is engine. Written by hand or by the agent on request, amended by the loop itself at runtime (reviewed edit, same pattern as meeting-types.json).

kind.description: Drives owner mode, private-channel defaults, consent + retention requirements, and gate shape.

last_confirmed.description: Whole-profile freshness. Loop re-asks stale decisions when they bite.

owner.description: Who 'my side' means. A person install has one; a company install must resolve an owner PER RUN or carry a roster.

roster_path.description: roster mode: file listing people + roles; used for owner-tagged action items and recap recipients

venv_root.description: machine-local, NEVER inside a synced/committed directory

hf_allowed.description: false => never offer pyannote; diarizer order starts at diarize_no_hf.py

llm.description: Which language model serves each lane. The ENGINE needs no LLM at all (ASR is a speech model, diarization is clustering, routing/merge/render are deterministic). Only the synthesis lanes do. See references/llm-tiers.md.

mode.description: none = deterministic pipeline only, output is a transcript + candidate-item list a human triages. local = on-device (Ollama/llama.cpp) for installs that may not send transcripts off the machine. split = small model on the volume lane, frontier on the judgment lane (recommended).

volume_lane.description: cleaning + classification triage. Long inputs, mechanical work, parallel. Cheapest capable model wins.

judgment_lane.description: intent decode, note merges, execution planning, distillation dedup. Short inputs, expensive mistakes. Do not economize here.

egress_allowed.description: false => transcripts must never leave the machine. Forces mode to none|local and caps distillation. Set true only when the consent policy and the destination actually permit it.

max_level_without_llm.description: With mode:none the pipeline cannot exceed capture-only. Entity merges and concept dedup are judgment, not string matching.

brain.description: The user's knowledge architecture. See references/brain-adapters.md for the adapter contract and write strategies.

capability.description: direct-write = filesystem. handoff = we emit files and the user/API imports them; never claim a write we cannot make.

folder_map.description: Per output artifact, where it lands. Keys are artifact ids; values are paths relative to root. Missing key = ask before first write.

entity_registry.description: optional file listing known clients/projects/bands so routing targets can be CONFIRMED against a list instead of typed free-hand

conventions_doc.description: optional path to the brain's own rules (CLAUDE.md, README, style guide). Read at Step 0 so output matches house style instead of imposing ours.

level.description: L0 capture-only (transcript + action items, no knowledge extraction). L1 entity-notes (living per-entity notes merged). L2 atomic-concepts (reusable concepts wicked into a wiki). L2 requires link_dialect != none AND an existing wiki.

engine.description: skill that performs L2, e.g. second-brain-ingest, project-brain. null when level < L2.

decoupled.description: true = extract now, distill later (background/on-command). Heavy semantic passes must never block the action-items lane.

cite_back.description: every distilled claim links to the meeting note it came from

destination_shared.description: Is the brain root synced, pushed, or shared with anyone? THE safety-critical answer. true => privacy routing is load-bearing, not decorative, and private_root becomes required.

audience.description: WHO can see the shared destination. One boolean cannot distinguish a solo multi-device sync from a public repo, and the right routing differs: solo-sync leaks only to your own devices; private-remote leaks into git history; team leaks to colleagues (changes the Channel B calculus); public leaks to everyone.

vcs_autocommit.description: true = something auto-commits this tree (cron, sync daemon). A 'PRIVATE' banner is not a control in that case.

private_root.description: Absolute path OUTSIDE the shared tree for sensitive transcripts + raw. Required when destination_shared is true. Step 0 REFUSES a private_root that resolves under brain.root while vcs_autocommit is true — that is the leak the field exists to prevent, and a warning is not enough.

private_root_exception.description: Only way to run a private_root inside the shared tree. Requires an explicit, dated, human justification. Absent this, Step 0 refuses.

sensitive_default_types.description: meeting-type ids that route sensitive by default

people.description: Channel B — private dossiers on OTHER humans. Default OFF for company installs (HR/legal surface).

name_map.description: answer key for transcript mis-hears and look-alike names

identity.description: Channel C — the OWNER's own durable belief-lines. Off unless an identity root exists.

distill_command.description: Invoked as part of meeting-loop Step 7c after the Channel C drop (not deferred).

ai_handoff.description: Channel D — AI-command extraction (Step 7d). Lines addressed to an AI agent become a separate, paste-ready handoff with waves, gates and an inline grill. Default ON; per-type opt-out via meeting-types.json ai_handoff: false.

queue_path.description: central finder index dir; default Inbox/handoffs/ai-queue

default_target.description: agent slug used when the speaker says 'the AI' / 'have it' with no name; default claude

marker_spans.description: how the owner flags work live: handing the floor to an agent opens a marked span, taking it back closes it, and everything between becomes items even with no agent addressed. These are EXAMPLES of an intent for a judgment agent, not a match list. Per-machine: this skill is shared, the profile is not.

targets.description: agents this install knows. ANY agent name spoken in a meeting is still captured (slugged as spoken); this list only adds labels, aliases and paste notes.

paste_note.description: one line shown above that target's paste block

jurisdiction_note.description: e.g. two-party-consent state; surfaced once per new participant

capture.description: How they ACTUALLY record. Sets attribution expectations honestly up front instead of after disappointment.

vocab_prime.description: proper nouns + jargon passed to --prompt so the ASR stops mangling them

execution.description: Step 8f. What gets DONE vs listed.

approver.description: person name, or role title for company installs

dispatch_via.description: Ordered agent chain every execution task routes through, to keep main context lean (e.g. ['lead-agent','specialist-agent']). Empty = dispatch directly. Step 8f must NOT hardcode a chain.

integrations.description: What this install can actually DO. An integration not listed here never appears in an execution plan AND never fires as a standalone offer (Step 10 included).

capability.description: e.g. website-edit, client-email, proposal, task-tracker, crm-push

target.description: WHERE it acts — endpoint, database, account handle, repo. Without this a runner script points wherever it was authored to point, which on a copied profile is someone else's production system.

irreversible.description: send/deploy/publish/pay — gets its own confirm at the moment of action, even after plan approval

invocable_by_model.description: false => emit a HANDOFF block, never a task line claiming we ran it

handoff.description: Required when invocable_by_model is false. Step 8f renders the handoff FROM THIS, never from a hardcoded ladder — an install without those commands must not be told to run them.

brief_artifact.description: the artifact the next session reads first

ladder.description: ordered commands for this item's size; may be keyed by size in the seed prompt

seed_prompt.description: paste-ready line that opens the fresh session, naming the brief path

prereq.description: setup that must exist first, e.g. an issue tracker

client_facing_gate.description: voice/quality gate every outward artifact passes, e.g. a voice or style-guide checker. null = none configured; say so plainly rather than implying a check happened.

compliance.description: Field-specific obligations. Grounded in references/field-requirements.md (research 2026-08-23). Absent = unregulated personal install; every gate below is off. NOT legal advice — this encodes what the research found so the tool asks instead of assuming.

regime.description: Which regimes apply. Drives every gate below. Multiple is normal — a research hospital is hipaa + irb-common-rule + fda-part-11.

processor_contract.description: The contract that makes cloud egress lawful. `llm.egress_allowed: true` WITHOUT one of these is the single most common violation in this product category — a staffer's personal notetaker account is not covered by any of them. HIPAA needs a BAA; FERPA needs the §99.31(a)(1) school-official exception with direct control; SEC 17a-4(f) needs a designated-third-party undertaking.

originals.description: Distinct from retention. Several regimes require the ORIGINAL be captured and preserved BEFORE any AI processing, because the summary is only ever a derivative.

summary_may_be_the_record.description: false in every field researched. Government minutes are a required summary, but the CLERK certifies them — the AI output is still a draft.

audit_trail.description: Record which audio, which model and version, what was edited, by whom, when. Entry ticket for financial services (17a-4(f)), Part 11/ALCOA+ for research, and reproducibility for insurance bad-faith discovery.

review_required.description: An artifact is a DRAFT until a named human reviews it. Unreviewed AI output is discoverable and can convert hedged statements into apparent admissions. Also the CA AB 3030 exemption route.

legal_hold.description: When true, the Step 8 retention sweep is SUSPENDED — no deletion offers, no expiry reporting as actionable. Overrides both retention minimums and mandatory-destruction duties.

segregated_artifacts.description: This meeting type must emit TWO artifacts with different governance, never one merged note. Required for psychotherapy: under 45 CFR 164.501 merging process notes with diagnosis/progress/billing destroys the §164.508 authorization protection. Emit two or none.

biometric_processing.description: Acoustic diarization computes speaker embeddings — that is voiceprint extraction, regulated under BIPA and Art. 9 GDPR, and pleaded in In re Otter.AI. Two-mic energy comparison builds no embedding and is exempt.

consent_basis.description: required when allowed is true and a biometric regime is in scope

inference_limits.description: EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(f), live since 2026-02-02, prohibits inferring emotions in workplace and education contexts.

emotion_inference.description: false => Channel B must not characterize temperament, mood, or decision style. Set false for EU workplace/education installs regardless of install.kind.

scoring_ranking.description: false => never score, rank, or recommend on people. true in a hiring context pulls you into AI Act Annex III point 4 and NYC LL144.

consent_matrix.description: Consent is not a flat state list — the medium is a second dimension (Oregon is all-party in person, one-party by phone) and multi-state calls key off EVERY participant's location, not the host's.

works_council_required.description: DE §87(1) no.6 BetrVG triggers on technical CAPABILITY to monitor, not intent — speaker attribution alone can trigger it. NL WOR Art. 27 is a consent right. Employee consent does NOT substitute. Blocks rollout until agreed.

refuse_types.description: Meeting types this install must refuse outright rather than judge at runtime — e.g. group therapy (multiple patients' PHI in one file), closed executive session (TX §551.104(c) disclosure is a Class B misdemeanor), anonymous-source interviews on a cloud path.

types_registry.description: path to this install's meeting-type registry. Generated by the grill from the types the user ACTUALLY records — not the five shipped defaults.

decisions.description: Decay ledger. Every grill answer recorded with its date. When a decision bites at runtime and is older than the staleness window, the loop re-asks it instead of trusting it.

source.description: detected answers never count as confirmed decisions

archive.description: Optional. Where raw audio is MIRRORED after Step 8 files land. Absent means Step 8i is skipped entirely — never upload someone else's audio to a remote they did not name.

enabled.description: false or absent → Step 8i does not run.

remote.description: Name of an already-configured remote. The skill never configures one.

root.description: Top folder on the remote. Default 'Meeting Loop'.

mirror_sensitive.description: Mirror recordings Step 8 routed to privacy.private_root. Default false — the audio would otherwise leave the private root.
